id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Must match the manifest file name (without .json).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version understood by the launcher.

localizedText.description: User-facing text. English is mandatory and is the fallback for every other locale.

gitSource.description: Pinned upstream source. 'commit' is the only value used for builds; 'ref' documents where the pin comes from.

configValue.description: A value written to an emulator .conf file. Booleans are expressed as 0/1 like the upstream files.

configFilePath.description: Path of a config file relative to the instance 'conf' directory, e.g. 'worldserver.conf' or 'modules/mod_ahbot.conf'.

spdxLicense.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream license, or NOASSERTION when upstream declares none.

dbConnections.description: Every config entry holding this database's 'host;port;user;password;schema' connection string. The launcher rewrites all of them.
